title: Pipeline As Product
definition: The concept that the pipeline itself is the product of value, rather than the end result of the pipeline.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of a factory assembly line. Instead of just focusing on the final product, we can see that the entire pipeline — from raw materials to the finished product — is a valuable process in itself. This is similar to our conversation.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: In the conversation, we discussed the pipeline as a sequence of phases that feed into each other. The insight is that the pipeline itself is the product of value, rather than just the end result.
difficulty_levels.expert: The pipeline-as-product concept has implications in various fields such as software development, project management, and organizational structure. Focusing on the pipeline rather than the end result encourages continuous improvement and optimization. Moreover, this concept highlights the importance of understanding the entire process, not just the final outcome.

extra_fields.insight: The concept that the pipeline itself is the product of value, emphasizing the importance of continuous improvement and optimization.
